title: PRD: SignalSafe Adaptive Endpoint — deterministic seeding, eval gates, and regional fallback playbook
creator: Asha Patel
description: High-level PRD describing a compact, adaptive hosted endpoint (SignalSafe) that converges generation, embeddings, and rerank modes under one interaction surface while guaranteeing deterministic seeding for repeatable evals, eval-gated rollout decisions, and automated regional fallback policies. The goal is a single consumer-facing endpoint that preserves behavior contracts during rollouts and offers predictable cost and latency profiles for production consumers.
scope: Design the behavioral contract for mixed-mode inference (generate/embedding/rerank), implement deterministic request seeding options (per-tenant and global), define eval-gated acceptance pipelines integrated with our CI/eval system, and implement policy-driven regional fallback and canary orchestration. Provide console dashboards and telemetry hooks for rollout decisions.
out_of_scope: Model training, model onboarding of new architectures, private deployment packaging (VPC/on-prem) for this iteration, deep changes to runtime kernel selection. Dedicated-reserved capacity autoscaling tuning will be handled in a follow-up project.
goals: 1) Provide a stable deterministic seeding mode enabling identical outputs for controlled eval prompt suites. 2) Gate canary and progressive rollouts on eval pass/fail thresholds. 3) Reduce noisy deployment rollbacks by automating region-aware fallbacks to compatible model variants. 4) Ship an acceptance checklist and console views so PM/Eng/Design can clear release gates.
success_metrics: Eval gate pass rate >= 98% for target prompt set during canary
Canary rollback incidents reduced by 60% compared to baseline rollouts
95th percentile tail latency within SLO (hosted-tier: 350ms for gen small requests, 80ms for embeddings) during canary
Deterministic-seeded output divergence <= 0.01 measured by normalized edit distance on eval set
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic seeding API parameter implemented: seed_mode = {off, tenant_seed, global_seed} with documented semantics
Eval harness integration: CI job auto-runs specified eval suite on canary traffic and reports pass/fail to rollout controller
Rollout controller supports staged percentages (0,1,5,25,50,100) and automatic pause/rollback based on eval/telemetry thresholds
Regional fallback policy: traffic in failing region automatically reroutes to nearest healthy region or compatible model variant with documented cost and latency tradeoffs
Observability: console dashboard surfaces token-level cost, per-route latency, eval results, and canary status; alerts created for SLO breaches and eval gate failures
Documentation: public API spec updated with examples for mixed-mode calls, seeding, and structured outputs; internal runbook for rollback and postmortem checklist published
Security & compliance: seeding implementation passes security review and does not expose sensitive customer data via deterministic salts
launch_checklist: Finalize API contract and publish OpenAPI spec and SDK examples
Implement and validate eval harness with the canonical prompt set (sourced from PM-evals drive)
Create canary plan and schedule with SRE: define traffic slices, duration, and rollback criteria
Wire up console dashboards and smoke tests for token-cost and latency
Complete security review and KMS usage sign-off for any seeding salts
Document fallback policy and rehearse failover with runbook exercise
Coordinate downstream customers for opt-in canary and gather feedback window
Create GitHub PRs for runtime + orchestration and ensure at least two engineering approvals
Define post-launch monitoring window (14 days) and on-call rotation for rapid rollback
